resources.string: Keep model loaded after leaving chat

On by default. Returning to the model list keeps weights in memory, using RAM and possibly battery. Unload here or from the chat menu. Switching models or changing model configuration safely replaces the previous runtime. Android may still end the process; this does not start a background service.
Cleanup could not be confirmed. Do not load another model; restart the app.
Stop the local API and wait for cleanup before unloading its model.
The model is busy or this chat was replaced. Wait for generation to finish, then reopen settings.
